description: [$x402 pay-per-call] Converts an image to another format (png, jpg, webp, bmp, gif, tiff).

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded file contents (or data URL). Converted internally to multipart/form-data.

format.description: Target format: png, jpg/jpeg, webp, bmp, gif, or tiff.

x_payment.description: Optional. Signed x402 payment header (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / X-PAYMENT) from the caller. If omitted, returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements.

name: img_tools_convert
